locations.note: Welsh pirate Edward Kenway sails an open-world West Indies during the Golden Age of Piracy.
The Spanish colonial capital where Edward first poses as an Assassin.
The British-controlled port, one of the game's three main cities.
The pirate republic that Edward and his fellow captains try to build and defend.
The Assassin Brotherhood's hidden base lies in the Mayan temples of Tulum, where Edward first meets the Assassins and Mary Read later devotes herself to them.
Port Royal is a British port on the Caribbean map.
Edward makes Great Inagua the Jackdaw's hideout.
A chase for the Sage leads to Príncipe off the African coast.
Charleston is the northern end of the sailing map.
Port-au-Prince appears before the Freedom Cry story returns there.
